test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence contains four underlined words and are given as options. Identify the option that contains an error.

They were sitting __on__ the chairs in the class talking __to__ each other __when__ they entered __in__ a heated argument.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition "**in**" before the term "**a heated argument**."
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is "**into**" instead of "in".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**entered into a heated argument**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They were sitting on the chairs in the class talking to each other when they entered into a heated argument."*
